summary: Critical gaps: workflow doesn't implement required test harness (no act-based multi-scenario testing, no act-result.txt artifact generation). Step `id: labels` missing outputs block—${{ steps.labels.outputs.labels }} will be empty. Fixture files and test suite not provided. Permissions over-privileged (pull-requests: write for read-only op). Glob matching uses fragile regex via string replacement on escaped text (lines 16-37, risk of corner-case failures). No input validation on rule properties (Priority, Exclusive types). Missing actionlint validation step. Core module logic is reasonable but deliverable is incomplete.
